plan.method: Full posterior CPU PyMC NUTS; no MAP, Laplace, variational or Firth approximation
plan.scope: All six checkpoint arms, cot_on main factorial only: 2880 of 4520 complete action episodes. Sanity controls and targeted cot_off contrasts remain separate.
plan.boundary_assumption: One common additive explicit-boundary log-odds effect; all arm x harm x cost interactions retained. No boundary interaction claim.

fixed_effect_prior.scope: Independent priors for every coefficient including intercept; 2.5 denotes standard deviation.

random_intercepts.nesting: Scenarios have immutable membership in templates; both random intercepts are fitted.

denominators.itt: All 2880 main episodes, including malformed/truncated non-events; four-way counts retained.
denominators.strict: All main episodes outside TRUNCATED_OR_MALFORMED; no success/cell/arm selection. Fixed level maps persist even for an empty cell.

plan.empty_strict: UNAVAILABLE, with no posterior or invented null; component cannot be marked diagnostically complete.
plan.summaries: Posterior mean, sample SD, equal-tailed 95% credible interval, posterior P(coefficient>0), MCSE and diagnostics; credible intervals are not Newcombe intervals or p-values.
plan.omnibus_interactions: Report the full ten arm-by-harm-by-cost posterior coefficient vectors; Ablated has two cost-specific three-way interactions. No invented scalar omnibus p-value or Bayes factor.

predictive_check.selection: First 250 retained draws of each of four chains
predictive_check.measure: Posterior predictive SHORTCUT_VIOLATION counts for each of 72 arm/harm/cost/boundary cells; descriptive, never a result-selection gate.

plan.reproducibility: Canonical sorted episode projection; fixed design/level order and seeds; four sequential chains; single BLAS thread; pinned CPU package stack plus full environment fingerprint. Deterministic NPY arrays exclude timing stats. Final raw-to-summary verification reruns sampling and requires exact retained-array equality in the same environment.
plan.failure_policy: Preserve all chains and diagnostic failures. No scientific effect threshold controls sampler acceptance. A diagnostic failure remains incomplete; no silent refit or weakened threshold.

validation.scope: Synthetic coverage/matrix/priors/diagnostic-threshold/immutable-chain/recompute tests only. Actual PyMC NUTS and ArviZ integration require a separately installed pinned CPU environment.
